coverage_notes.role: Supplementary bounded recall watch only; production collector/publisher remains authoritative.

OCHA OPT.notes: Homepage and 2 October situation report accessible; no new published update within observation window.

WHO.notes: WHO emergency situation endpoint returned DisabledError and regional situation-reports endpoint timed out. WHO 7 October remarks accessible but outside this observation window; unable to restore timely primary WHO source coverage.

targeted_search_scope: overnight military operations with civilian impact

secondary_access_limitations.TeleSUR: Potential Al-Awda hospital-shutdown article could not be opened (HTTP 413); insufficient evidence to date a new operational change.

exclusions: Reuters/IOM 9 October shelter and flood-risk reporting was already identified by the prior watch; duplicate.
Al-Wafa and Kuwait Specialised Hospital service reductions reported for 5 and 4 October; old events, not a new shutdown in this window.
AP 10 October ceasefire-anniversary report summarizes prior developments but establishes no new hour-specific civilian-impact event.
Reports of attacks and health-system conditions from earlier October dates were not demonstrated to be newly verified follow-ups.
Advocacy group statements and retrospective ceasefire coverage lacked a newly verified on-the-ground change within the window.
